charlieshort5.0: Silas Charlieshort came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Silas Charlieshort watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Dietrich Johnmetheny, badly wounded. Silas Charlieshort cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Charlieshort answered to number 910. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Silas Charlieshort wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Silas Charlieshort ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Silas Charlieshort. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Silas Charlieshort's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.

Silas Charlieshort fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Hugo Mrcakerson, now grazed. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Silas Charlieshort waited for that to change. When it did, Viktor Noobly was gravely wounded.
Silas Charlieshort rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Nils Hellcat was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Silas Charlieshort saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
dallas_bernhoester: Quentin "Mole" Bernhoester arrived on Day 16 as a replacement. The men in W-F8 had been fighting for 16 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Quentin "Mole" Bernhoester watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Quentin "Mole" Bernhoester anyway.
drkevlagg: Day 8. The corporal put Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Asked what he will do after the war, Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg said: 'Be a butcher's boy in Dunmarrow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg is number 600. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Clement Ther was badly wounded.
A second spoon disappeared. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Leopold Domgas was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
At R-S16 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg won the bet. Gideon "Saint" Schu was grazed.
gothic_enthusiast: The new sapper is Anselm Enthusiast, once a brewer from Lindenbruck. The corporal asked if a brewer was any use in a trench. Anselm Enthusiast said he would find out.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Anselm Enthusiast helped stack spare sandbags at S-C14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Anselm Enthusiast found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. The clerk counted the names twice. Anselm Enthusiast is number 721 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C14, Anselm Enthusiast listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Anselm Enthusiast found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Anselm Enthusiast ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Anselm Enthusiast was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Anselm Enthusiast traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Anselm Enthusiast whistles the same four notes over and over. Today, under fire at the Chalk Pits, that habit was the only steady thing in S-C14.

Anselm Enthusiast was blown off the fire step at S-C14. He is alive, barely, and the bearers are carrying him back as fast as they can. Anselm Enthusiast held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
A letter came with Bram Enthusiast: "I am Anselm Enthusiast's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
hayden.dt: Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden introduced himself as a blacksmith from Rosenau. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
One of the first hundred, Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
After what happened at the Brickworks, Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden asked to serve as a field cook. Nobody argued.
A crow sat on the parapet above Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden all afternoon. The men say it chose him.

Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Karel Check and Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

A shell landed square in R-F10. They found Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. The shell that hit R-F10 took Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden asked about Isidor "Rabbit" Hayden on arriving at R-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Pavel "Crow" Hayden answered the first call, number 73 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F10 holds again. Pavel "Crow" Hayden fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Oskar Eddie, grazed. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Pavel "Crow" Hayden helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. Pavel "Crow" Hayden became a signaller today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Pavel "Crow" Hayden and Teodor Roos argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home found Pavel "Crow" Hayden before the night shift. Pavel "Crow" Hayden folded it small and kept it close.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F10 and grazed Pavel "Crow" Hayden's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Rafael "Button" Superfeisty of the Concord (@superfeisty7).
Pavel "Crow" Hayden's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F10 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

A bullet found Pavel "Crow" Hayden at R-F10, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Pavel "Crow" Hayden fell at R-F10 and never moved again. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).

The House of Hayden sent Gideon Hayden after Pavel "Crow" Hayden. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Gideon Hayden is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave. Gideon Hayden's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

At R-F10 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Gideon Hayden turned around and took a shovel blow. Quentin Adams of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Quentin Adams of the Concord (@_smokey_adams_). Blackwater Canal has been won. Gideon Hayden listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home found Gideon Hayden before the night shift. Gideon Hayden folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Hayden is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Gideon Hayden helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Gideon Hayden washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. A letter from home found Gideon Hayden before the night shift. Gideon Hayden folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Hayden sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line. A letter from home found Gideon Hayden before the night shift. Gideon Hayden folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through the rim of Gideon Hayden's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. A letter from home found Gideon Hayden before the night shift. Gideon Hayden folded it small and kept it close.

A round came through the loophole Gideon Hayden was watching at R-F10 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Gustav Egga of the Concord (@egga15627). Gideon Hayden stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F10. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gustav Egga of the Concord (@egga15627).
The papers connected Zeno Hayden to Gideon Hayden. The men took longer to learn Zeno Hayden's own habits, but they made the effort.

The Concord sentry, Jonas Steini, shouted once. Zeno Hayden silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@steini10.02) Zeno Hayden went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Norbert "Lucky" Mart put up a fight, but not for long. (@frank_mart00) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Zeno Hayden was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Zeno Hayden reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Zeno Hayden died in the hospital bed despite everything the surgeon tried. a cracked shaving mirror was in his hand at the end.
Marek Hayden had heard about Zeno Hayden's courage. At R-F10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Marek Hayden took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Marek Hayden found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Marek Hayden read it while the kettle boiled.
heresyandchill: On Day 10 Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi took a post at U-F14 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He never sits with his back to the parapet, and the men liked him for it.

Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi and Yann Zebra divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Yann Zebra fixed the strap on Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Drowned Farm in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. Mail came up the line with a letter for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The reply to Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn. A letter came for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi pinned it to the dugout wall.

Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Dorian Thecommander, badly wounded. The letter for Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi smelled faintly of soap. Oskar "Ghost" Heresyandchi held it close for a long time before opening it.
jgdiaz714: Day 17: Quentin Jgdiaz reached W-F12 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
kobi_brick06: The draft reached P-F24 on Day 10. Tobias "Owl" Brick was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Tobias "Owl" Brick and Norbert Daddy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Tobias "Owl" Brick looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The last report placed Tobias "Owl" Brick near the Brickworks. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing.
Tobias "Owl" Brick's letters keep arriving at P-F24. The sergeant puts them in a tin and does not open them.
Nobody at P-F24 has seen Tobias "Owl" Brick since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.
A patrol went out looking for Tobias "Owl" Brick last night and came back with a torn glove. Nobody is sure it was his.
Tobias "Owl" Brick came back exhausted, having waited in cover until the way cleared. He slept through the argument about who had worried most.
Tobias "Owl" Brick watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
lemonade_lover393: The new rifleman is Bastian Lover, once a tailor from Greyhallow. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Bastian Lover said he would find out.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Lover folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A round went through the rim of Bastian Lover's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Wendel Superfeisty of the Concord (@superfeisty7). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Bastian Lover during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Back on the fire step at R-R6. Bastian Lover says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
An empty jam tin became Bastian Lover's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Bastian Lover and Casimir Slive share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Bastian Lover spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Bastian Lover has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
Bastian Lover saved the last of the sugar for Arno "Shadow" Meloche's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Shadow's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
sam.ricks: Arno Ricks took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Arno Ricks of the Concord and Roland Theelliottma of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Hill 304. It is getting crowded.
Arno Ricks offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S13, Arno Ricks listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Arno Ricks found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno Ricks is number 496. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Arno Ricks kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Arno Ricks carried Wendel Thewilliampo's rifle all the way up to the Chalk Pits after Wendel twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
Arno Ricks opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Arno Ricks sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Arno Ricks fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Quentin "Spark" Josiascouper was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.

Arno Ricks had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Casimir Lilsaint, grazed. Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Viktor Tetanusmaxxe stood up to sing louder, and Arno Ricks fired. Viktor Tetanusmaxxe was grazed. The singing stopped.

Arno Ricks saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S13 and fired once. Zeno Midnight was badly wounded. The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Arno Ricks waited for that to change. When it did, Cyril Rotten was gravely wounded. Arno Ricks fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Ulrich Zelenszki, now grazed.
serdr.tg: On Day 10, Teodor Serdr arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Teodor Serdr waited for that to change. When it did, Emil Sammmmyv was grazed. Teodor Serdr left the work of a rifleman to become a field cook. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F14, Teodor Serdr listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Listening post, three in the morning. Teodor Serdr heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Teodor Serdr. Teodor Serdr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Teodor Serdr said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Teodor Serdr approved the method.
Teodor Serdr obtained a recipe for a simple onion bread. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
Teodor Serdr made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
New laces made Teodor Serdr's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
teamkaylin: On Day 9, Bastian Teamkaylin arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F20, Bastian Teamkaylin listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Bastian Teamkaylin was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at T-F20. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988). Bastian Teamkaylin was killed outright at T-F20, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988).

Arno Teamkaylin put a tin of tobacco beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bastian Teamkaylin helped clear the shelf without saying why. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Arno Teamkaylin stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A man asked Arno Teamkaylin to describe Kesselby without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
A recruit asked Arno Teamkaylin how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
A crow sat on the parapet above Arno Teamkaylin all afternoon. The men say it chose him.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Arno Teamkaylin's ear at T-F20 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988).
Arno Teamkaylin walked back up the communication trench to T-F20, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Arno Teamkaylin and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen.
